subject: Dressing-room storage that feels calm
hook: Dressing rooms built around what you own.
gbp:
Want a bedroom or dressing room that stays calm, not just tidy for a weekend? SUPERIO designs and builds fitted wardrobes, walk-in wardrobes and dressing rooms made to measure for homes in Newcastle-under-Lyme and across Staffordshire.

We start by looking at what you actually own — long hanging, shirts, folded knitwear, shoes, bags — and size every section to suit. Internal drawers, shoe pull-outs and dividers give each item a fixed place, and one consistent finish keeps the room visually quiet.

What's included: a free, no-obligation design consultation; a full measure and an itemised quote with transparent pricing; manufacture in our own workshop in Hanley, quality-checked before it leaves; and delivery and installation by our own team. Finishes include matt white, oak-effect, charcoal and black woodgrain, with soft-close hardware as standard and a choice of antique gold or matt black handles.

Book a free design consultation to talk through your room.
